messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: warmup failure surge detected for model 'redwood-lite-13b' in us-west1 — 18% warmup failures, spike in 5xx. Paging on-call (pager=maya).

maya (oncall): I'm on. Any recent deploys or artifact promotions? @ryan?

ryan (eng-runtime): no model deploys in the last 2h. We rolled an internal JIT tweak yesterday to canary nodes. pulling warmup logs now.

ana (sre): observed symptoms: k8s node us-west3 has repeated restarts for pods shim-redwood-13b-*-warmup. Crash loop with OOMKilled then compile timeout after restart.

maya (oncall): customer impact? @liz please triage.

liz (support): two customers reporting 503s from us-west region starting ~09:02 PT. traffic spikes of failed requests ~30rps sustained for ~8-10m. opening incident page.

ryan (eng-runtime): tailing warmup logs: ```
[09:01:45] WARN warmup: deserializing shard 2 failed: unexpected EOF reading weights
[09:01:45] ERROR runtime: compile kernel timed out after 30s for op fused_attn
[09:01:46] ERROR cuda: out of memory allocating 1.2GB
[09:01:47] INFO fallback: trying quantized q4_0 variant
```

maya (oncall): order of failures unclear — corrupted artifact -> compile churn -> OOM? Which started it?

ryan (eng-runtime): hypothesis: truncated shard caused heavy allocations during JIT/compile path; compile attempts spike memory use and hit OOM, then compile timeout triggers fallback that also sometimes OOMs.

james (infra): scanning storage logs: a transfer to us-west-cache-1 had an etag/checksum mismatch at 08:58:12. That upload likely produced a truncated blob.

maya (oncall): mitigation plan? Need to restore healthy traffic quickly and curb restart noise.

ryan (eng-runtime): immediate steps: 1) divert routing to stable resident variant redwood-lite-13b-v2 in us-west; 2) temporarily disable concurrent warmup on new pods; 3) consider raising COMPILE_TIMEOUT to 60s for warmup agents (tradeoffs).

ana (sre): executing route switch and warmup throttling now.

ana (sre): `redwood route update --region us-west1 --model redwood-lite-13b -> redwood-lite-13b-v2 --weight 100%`

deploy-bot: route update triggered by ana at 09:08 PT.

ana (sre): also PATCHing warmup config: `PATCH /config/warmup?concurrency=1` on us-west pool.

james (infra): marking artifact uploads to cache as suspect. Kicking off re-sync from central S3 to us-west cache; ETA ~12m for full 13B shard set.

liz (support): customer comms: "We're routing traffic to a stable variant while we investigate warmup failures in us-west. We'll provide updates in 15-30m."

ryan (eng-runtime): post-switch logs: ```
[09:09:30] INFO routing: traffic -> redwood-lite-13b-v2 (100%)
[09:09:32] INFO warmup: suppression enabled for new instances
[09:09:33] INFO runtime: error rate dropping from 18% to ~1.2% in 90s
```

maya (oncall): are errors still coming in? @liz?

liz (support): new ticket rate dropped; existing tickets updated with mitigation note.

ryan (eng-runtime): refined root cause: corrupted shard(s) in us-west cache (etag mismatch) -> truncated deserializations -> JIT/compile path behaves badly causing higher memory churn and compile timeouts -> container restarts/OOM.

james (infra): confirmed etag mismatch for shard-2. Invalidation and re-upload in progress.

maya (oncall): recommended follow-ups and permanent fixes?

ryan (eng-runtime): short-term: finish cache re-sync; add runtime checksum verify on deserialize and fast-fail to avoid mmaping partial blobs; bump warmup pod mem limit temporarily. Long-term: add canary verification in artifact promotion and stronger telemetry around compile timeouts and memory pressure.

james (infra): bumped warmup pod memory from 24Gi -> 32Gi in affected pool; rolling restart underway to pick up fresh shards.

nana (sre): adding post-incident task: artifact promotion canary + checksum validation in pipeline.

maya (oncall): customer impact summary: two mid-market customers affected; window 09:02–09:10 PT; peak failure rate ~18%; primary symptom 503/504 errors. No data loss or security exposure.

liz (support): both tenants accepted rollback to stable variant; one requested an emailed postmortem.

ryan (eng-runtime): additional debug snippet from failing pod: ```
FATAL: runtime panic: attempted to mmap 0x1f00000000 bytes -> failed: cannot allocate memory
...
cause: deserializing weights: read 0x3f, expected 0xbeef
```

james (infra): cache re-sync progress: 40% done for model shards; est finish ~09:20 PT.

maya (oncall): proposal: mark mitigated once re-sync completes and error rate <1% for 5m. objections?

nana (sre): agree, will monitor.

ryan (eng-runtime): creating follow-up action items: ["runtime:fast-fail-on-checksum-mismatch","infra:artifact-promotion-canary","telemetry:compile-timeout-alerts","runtime:prefer-resident-quantized-fallbacks"]

deploy-bot: INC-2026-2098 created and assigned to eng-runtime + infra.

maya (oncall): marking status: mitigated (traffic routed to stable model). staying on thread until SLOs validated.

liz (support): customer outbound scheduled for 09:25 PT. drafting postmortem email for review.

nana (sre): re-sync completed at 09:19 PT; checksums verified for all shards; error rate steady <0.5% for 6m.

ryan (eng-runtime): rolling hotfix: fast-fail checksum mismatch, log artifact origin & hash, avoid partial mmap attempts. patch deployed to warmup agent fleet.

maya (oncall): thanks. Recommend we delay additional JIT scheduler changes until artifact validation is in place; possible interactions increase memory churn.

liz (support): sending postmortem draft to ops; will include customer impact summary and remediation steps.

maya (oncall): closing loop: incident will be closed after postmortem is published and customer notes are sent. :white_check_mark:
